title: Total open Čech resolution comparison with derived evaluation
statement: Let X be any scheme, i:X.Opens → X.Etale a cover-preserving finite-limit-preserving functor, with i(top) terminal. Let U be a finite u-small open family with supremum top. Let G be any étale abelian sheaf in universe u+1, assume its sheaf category has injective resolutions, and let I be any injective resolution of G. For each n≥0 the degree-n homology of the total of the actual double complex D=C^p(U,i^*I^q) [def-sc-etale-open-cech-resolution-double-complex] is isomorphic to (R^n ev_i(top))(G). Neither separatedness, affine opens, nor acyclicity of G is assumed; the assertion involves the total resolution and not the sections Čech complex.

source.place: Original proof step 2: the injective Čech augmentation and total-complex abutment comparison

proof.text: Construct restriction_0 by Pi.lift of J.map (i.map (homOfLE le_top)).op. Prove naturality by Pi.hom_ext and NatTrans.naturality. Expand the degree-zero Cech differential into its two faces; functoriality and uniqueness of arrows into the top open make the two restrictions equal, so their signed sum vanishes. Apply these restrictions termwise to I.cocomplex to construct a chain map a from the evaluated resolution A to D.X 0, with a followed by D.d 0 1 zero. These constructions require no covering or injectivity hypotheses.

Construct b:A→Tot(D) by a.f q followed by the (0,q) total inclusion. The total differential formulas split into horizontal and vertical parts. The horizontal term vanishes by the preceding calculation; both signs at (0,q) are +1. Naturality of a then proves the chain map identity.

For each resolution degree q, apply etaleOpenCechInjectiveAugmentation_quasiIso to the injective sheaf I.cocomplex.X q. CochainComplex.fromSingle_0Equiv identifies the degree-zero component with a.f q, and Pi.lift_pi verifies its restriction projections. Apply quasiIso_of_column_augmentation with these row quasi-isomorphisms and the defining component equality for b.

Invert isoOfQuasiIsoAt b n and compose with the inverse of I.isoRightDerivedObj F n, where F is sheaf-to-presheaf followed by evaluation at i(top). This yields the stated isomorphism from total homology to derived evaluation.

proof_origin.place: Original row-augmentation route; explicit restriction and total maps, first-quadrant criterion, then Mathlib InjectiveResolution.isoRightDerivedObj. G1 stage 3, 2026-10-13.
